Ava Wallace: Heads up 1: Nimbus Robotics invoice NIM-2025-08 (USD 87,300) is 68 days past due. Customer is disputing a $18k usage overage linked to a spike during our patch window. They want a credit and a payment hold while they investigate. Need approach: do we accept hold + partial payment? @Marcus can you confirm the usage logs?

Marcus Li: I pulled the logs. There was a 3-hour spike on 2025-10-12 during their nightly job; it looks legitimate and billable per contract. No throttling on our side.

Sofia Gomez: Contract has an exceptions clause but usage above committed baseline is billable. We can offer a one-time credit up to 20% if they sign a short settlement and pay 50% now. Otherwise we follow standard dunning.

Trevor Holt: Sales asks to avoid churn. Suggest 50% immediate payment, 25% in 30 days, 25% in 60 days, plus a documented credit of $9,000 applied to next invoice if they close the dispute within 14 days. No service restore until initial clears.

Ava Wallace: Proposed message to customer below  please review.

Ava Wallace:
```
Subject: Resolution and payment options for invoice NIM-2025-08

Hi Samir,

Thanks for flagging the usage spike. We reviewed logs and can offer a compromise to resolve quickly: 50% payment due now, 25% due in 30 days, 25% due in 60 days. Additionally, we'll apply a $9,000 credit to your next invoice if you accept and sign the settlement within 14 days. Service will remain suspended until the initial payment clears.

If you prefer to hold payment pending your internal audit, please confirm the timeline; otherwise we'll need to initiate collections per contract after 72 hours.

Regards,
Ava Wallace
Finance Ops
```

Sofia Gomez: Also include a one-click agreement link and require PO or signed amendment if they want credit applied.

Trevor Holt: I'll have Sales join the thread after you send. If they accept but later miss installment 2, we should escalate to Legal/Collections. No renewals until cleared.

Ava Wallace: I'll send at 10:15 PT and attach logs + agreement link. If no signed settlement in 72h, we escalate. Tracking here for audit. :memo:
